$comment: Contract for the SetPagePermission server-side command (AD-003, AD-041). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_SetPagePermission
customApi.description: Administrator sets the access level a role has on a resource key, a page or capability (AD-041). Enforces the caller holds Manage on permission.manage, upserts al_pagepermission idempotently and writes an immutable Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: AppRole
requestParameters.description: Built-in role the rule applies to. Omit when RoleCode is supplied.

requestParameters.name: RoleCode
requestParameters.description: Optional. Stable al_role code for a custom role (AD-044). When supplied, it takes precedence over AppRole.

requestParameters.name: ResourceKey
requestParameters.description: Governed page or capability key, e.g. page.exports or command.regrade.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same rule.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when an optimistic-concurrency conflict was detected.
